name: Page Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Page Industries Limited is the exclusive licensee of JOCKEY International Inc. for manufacturing, distribution, and marketing of the JOCKEY® brand in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, and the UAE. Page Industries is also the exclusive licensee of Speedo International Ltd. for the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of the Speedo brand in India.
keyPoints: Brand & Product Portfolio a) Jockey: Page holds exclusive rights to manufacture, distribute and market Jockey products in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Maldives, Bhutan, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. The portfolio includes men's, women's and kids' innerwear, athleisure, outerwear, socks, thermals, towels and accessories. b) Speedo: The company manufactures and markets swimwear, swimming equipment, water shorts, apparel and footwear under the Speedo brand in India. As of Q1FY27, Speedo was present through 663 multi-brand stores across 150 cities and 36 exclusive brand stores across 11 cities.[1][2]
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 47.0%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 96.8%
cons: Stock is trading at 22.3 times its book value
